items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled lemma at source lines 2161-2163: the induced map on the total space of the cover is 0-connected. The proof (source lines 2164-2177) carries the whole argument and is not visible in the statement: it unfolds connectedness through homotopy fibres, uses that contractibility is a mere proposition together with the surjectivity of k to reduce the base point to a value of k, builds the centre of contraction explicitly, then takes an arbitrary element of the truncation, uses the set-ness of the fibre truncation to assume it is given by an explicit point and path, performs an induction on the total space where the generator case is turned by the path constructor into an equality of homotopy-fibre points, and finally discharges the path-constructor case from set-ness alone. The reduction chain and the induction are the substance.
